source.howDecided: git log 3cf2963cd0..origin/main returns zero commits for packages/lib/server-only/field/create-envelope-fields.ts, packages/lib/server-only/field/set-fields-for-document.ts and packages/lib/advanced-fields-validation; all blobs are byte-identical between v2.16.0 and v2.17.0. Read create-envelope-fields.ts at origin/main and grepped it for the words readOnly, validate and advanced-fields: the only hits are the local variable name validatedFields at lines 139, 251 and 271. There is no import of packages/lib/advanced-fields-validation and no inspection of fieldMeta anywhere in the file's 327 lines. The block still opens at line 138 with the comment 'Field validation and placeholder resolution' and still checks only envelopeItemId membership, recipient existence and canRecipientFieldsBeModified; the write at lines 250-265 still passes `fieldMeta: field.fieldMeta` straight to tx.field.createManyAndReturn. packages/lib/types/field-meta.ts is unchanged too, so ZBaseFieldMeta still declares required and readOnly as two independent optional booleans with no cross-field refine. The bound doc is unchanged as well: apps/docs/content/docs/concepts/field-types.mdx is byte-identical at both revisions, so 'A field cannot be both required and read-only at the same time' still appears five times, once in each of the Text, Number, Radio, Checkbox and Dropdown Rules lists.

newItems.title: fix: don't create a field on top of an identical one
newItems.note: New community PR on the same create path, adding a duplicate-position guard. It adds no fieldMeta validation, so it neither fixes nor conflicts with this finding, but it does show the create path is being touched right now and a maintainer may want the two changes considered together.

newItems.title: Allow signature, initials and date fields to be optional
newItems.note: A feature request about the required flag on field types that currently force it. Same fieldMeta surface, opposite direction (loosen a constraint rather than enforce one). Not a duplicate.

citedItems.note: Unchanged: open, created 2026-08-05, last updated 2026-08-05, base main, 2 files +36/-5. Still inside validateNumberField, the shared validator this create path never calls.
Unchanged: open, created 2026-07-24, last updated 2026-07-26, base main, 2 files +97/-1. Same relation as #3152.

queries: gh search issues --repo documenso/documenso --include-prs --created ">=2026-08-01" --limit 100 (enumerates every issue and PR opened 2026-08-12 to 2026-08-19; 100 results)
gh search issues --repo documenso/documenso --include-prs --created "2026-08-01..2026-08-12" --limit 100 (fills the gap; 35 results)
gh search issues --repo documenso/documenso --include-prs --updated ">=2026-08-14" --created "<2026-08-01" --limit 60 (older items with activity since the review; 50 results)

gh search issues --repo documenso/documenso --include-prs "read-only" --limit 25 (25 results; the only field-validation ones are the already-cited #3152 and #3122 plus #2669 "Pre-filled readOnly TEXT field text overflows field border in signing preview", a rendering bug. Nothing reports that create-many accepts required+readOnly.)

reevaluation: The finding stands, unchanged. The create path, the shared validators it fails to call and the doc page that promises the rule are all byte-identical between the tested v2.16.0 and today's v2.17.0, so the gap now ships in two consecutive releases. Both cited PRs are still open and still only touch validateNumberField, confirming the review's reading that the community treats packages/lib/advanced-fields-validation as the home of these rules while the v2 create path bypasses it entirely. No new upstream item reports the gap. The review's caveat still applies and must survive into the filing: only the required+readOnly TEXT case was actually observed, because the run aborts at the first mismatch; the other eight forbidden configurations in the scenario are inference from 'no fieldMeta validation runs at all on this path', not evidence.
policyBasis: CONTRIBUTING.md: 'The most useful contribution is a detailed issue. Treat it like a spec.' plus '#3026: Most new PRs will be closed with a request to open an issue instead.' The fix is a small one and the temptation is to send a patch; the policy says do not.
notes: The issue should say the fix is already written elsewhere in the repo: createEnvelopeFields can call the same per-type validators that set-fields-for-document.ts:136-195 calls, and should throw AppError(AppErrorCode.INVALID_REQUEST) so the API answers 400, rather than the bare `new Error(errors.join(', '))` the setFields path throws today (which surfaces as a 500 even where the rules ARE enforced). Two scope facts to state: the same unvalidated service also backs the v1 POST /document/field/create-many, so this is not v2-only; and the doc states the rule as a product-wide invariant, repeating it in five separate Rules lists, so it cannot be dismissed as a stray sentence. Report only the observed TEXT case as observed and list the other eight as expected-but-unverified, or re-run them first if the live step covers it.
